text_block_list.text:
That day at Nakayama, a crowd gathered 
that was beyond comparison to a year 
ago... No, it was larger than any crowd 
for any race in the past.

“The clash of the century between the 
‘Monster’ Maruzensky and the ‘Emperor’ 
Symboli Rudolf. Everyone had gathered to 
witness history being made.”
And among them—
Coming through! Excuse me, let me pass!

W-Wait, hold on a moment! You're being so 
pushy...!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hyaa, it's so jam-packed! And it's still 
so early, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
J-Just getting through admission has 
already exhausted me...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, that's pathetic, McQueen! You're 
a stayer, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: That is a completely different matter!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she really is an amazing person. 
And besides—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd get to see a showdown between 
Maruzensky and Symboli Rudolf...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Who's stronger, the "Emperor" or the 
"Monster"...? I'm so thrilled to see this, 
I'm glad to be alive!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
—Everyone's talking only about Maruzen-san 
and the President. Even though the Arima 
Kinen is a race full of standout 
Umamusume...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even I have never experienced such fervent 
excitement before.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
That just shows how far ahead those two 
are. ...Mmm, I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll burn this into my memory, no matter 
what. The running of Symboli Rudolf—!
And as the crowd's expectations swelled—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: "—Well then, Trainer. I'm heading out."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: No, is that really all you have to say?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
The media and the fans alike are hyping 
this up as the showdown of the century.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"As a Trainer, shouldn't you be putting a 
little fire under your Trainee's feet?"
choice_data_list:
Because everything came through loud and 
clear.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Heh... I suppose so.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer-kun. For letting me 
shoulder those feelings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Once again, I'm heading out!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
――Hey, Maruzensky. Long time no see... I 
suppose.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Truly. For some reason, we hardly ever run 
into each other, do we?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Maruzeeeeen!! Rudooooolph!!
(WOOAAAH...!)

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ufu, what amazing excitement. Everyone's 
really looking forward to this.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
—Will the Emperor vanquish the monster, or 
will the monster gobble up the Emperor?♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Heh, my blood is pumping. I shall make a 
name for myself as the intrepid "Emperor."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I like that phrasing. Shall we go 
slay the monster right away?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
My, oh my, how dangerous. That's quite 
unlike our gentle President.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ambition is, on the whole, a ferocious 
thing. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"My orders today were to show my true 
colors, after all. Did I end up 
disillusioning you?"

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Not at all!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Now I'm craving it even more♪ Ufufu♪

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Before that, I shall thrust my blade into 
your back— and overtake you."

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Whoaaa! Just start already!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the audience is waiting eagerly 
as well.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Let us put on the greatest race ever seen, 
past or future.
